scope: Declared caller/state assumptions for the finite source-bound game profile; not a proof of whole-state or whole-game equivalence.
assumptions: Stage indices are 0..54; time/life setting indices are 0..4.
Player/world coordinates and actor data are source-width bytes; Subpixel is the recovered 0..255 output of UpdateSubpixel.
Score, NextLife, lives and remaining seconds are valid packed BCD; source score is six digits capped at 999999.
World tile IDs are 0..34 and object types are 0..27.
Actor slot arguments are 0..47; each switch following-slot count stays within the 48-slot pool.
AddObject finds a free slot. Full-pool behavior is an explicit capacity fault adaptation, not parity for the original unbounded RAM traversal.
Environmental HV/status inputs must be identical to claim a deterministic comparison. Boot RAM noise uses an explicit seed adapter.
All original data are bound to the exact qualified ROM hash.
excluded_from_component_claim: formal equivalence for every allowed state
all levels completed through ordinary controller play
pixel/timbre equivalence across different console hardware
